name: rfe-creator
description: Skills for creating, reviewing, splitting and submitting work items: RFEs to the RHAIRFE Jira project and Initiatives to RHAISTRAT, through one generic pipeline (/rfe-create, /rfe-review, /rfe-split, /rfe-submit, /rfe-auto-fix, /rfe-speedrun). Works for every registered type: RFEs by default, Initiatives with --type initiative. The legacy dotted names (/rfe.create and friends) remain as compatibility aliases.
